note: Measured peak storage of release regressions, read by tools/tbo/release_regression.mjs preflight. peak_bytes = free space at start minus the minimum observed during the run (it includes concurrent test outputs, the chunk cache and test temp). lower_bound: the run exhausted its disk, so the true peak was larger. Append only measured runs (--record-history); never edit a value by hand.

runs.measurement: footprint measured after the run, not by the watchdog (start free space was not recorded): worktree hybrid_v2/work 71 GiB (du -sh; p01 57 GiB, p02 14 GiB) + chunk cache 20,510,230,140 bytes (RUN.txt). Test temp (isolatedWork under %TEMP%) was not measured. Measured BEFORE segment hard-linking and post-assertion reclaim existed, so later runs should record lower peaks.
